stickyLayout.name: reTerminal Sticky
stickyLayout.description: Made for the Seeed reTerminal Sticky. A thin bar along the top of every scene (none on a scene set to full screen, as a reader is) shows the time, the date, the Wi-Fi signal and the battery; tap its left for the scene list and its right for the frame's settings. The scene list becomes a home screen with the same, big, and under it how to get around: what each key does and the swipes, as the frame's event map has them. Swipe up for the list and down for the settings, which hang from the bar. The Action key, the top one: pressed, go (what is picked opens); held, talk. Two keys pressed together are Back, and held the scene list. Or nothing: the scene on the whole glass. Its settings choose what it shows, the time format, white on black and the text size, and what the Action key does for it.
